subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this Google Chat `NO_REPLY` placeholder cleanup, or close that candidate and queue a replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open unmerged fork PR already claims it, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close or decline the stale fork PR if it is not maintainable, then queue a narrow current-main replacement that preserves contributor credit where appropriate.

options.title: Adopt and refresh the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the candidate path if maintainers can refresh it against current main, fix checks, and obtain real Google Chat proof.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the fork author only if maintainers expect fresh proof or branch activity soon.

recommendation.title: Close candidate and replace
recommendation.body: Close or decline the stale fork PR if it is not maintainable, then queue a narrow current-main replacement that preserves contributor credit where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery and channel-turn work makes this the best available owner for the landing-path decision.
